about: Board retreat, five nights near Chiang Rai (her ask 2026-11-02: 'a delightful hongdam minisite that stirs up anticipation of how great the retreat will be. Lots of calls to action, few words … workshops in traditional stuff and foraging, make it a 5 night thing. Lots of unique perqs and local flava'). tools/build_retreat.py writes docs/retreat/ and docs/th/retreat/. Plan for Beer: go/board-retreat. The resort is not named until it agrees (Su Khwan precedent).

en.title: Board retreat: five nights near Chiang Rai · Hongdam
en.desc: Five nights in the hills near Chiang Rai for a board that wants to work as one: question-only mornings, then indigo, lanterns and forest food. A suite each.
en.cardAlt: Five nights near Chiang Rai: a board retreat by Hongdam
en.lede: Questions in the morning. Indigo, lanterns and forest food in the afternoon. A suite each.
en.amL: Before you come: a private talk with each member.
en.trH: Try Troika at your next meeting
en.trDone: Done. Now picture five mornings of this.
en.pmL: Swap any afternoon. Tap the ones you want.
en.whereH: A suite each, in the hills
en.perBoard: a board of 8 to 14, five nights
en.hotel: Rooms and meals: the resort bills you, about {pp} a person.
en.fail: Not sent. LINE chat works too.
en.needContact: An email address or a LINE ID, please.
more: A private talk with each member before you come
A facilitator for five mornings; NaN, who runs Hongdam, hosts
A van with a driver all week
Your agreements typed within 5 days, a video check-in at 60 days, the same questions again at 6 months
en.bill: The resort bills rooms and meals. Hongdam (motdang.net Co., Ltd.) bills the retreat. Tax invoices in Thai and English.
en.lang: English or Thai. An interpreter for a mixed board.
